metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a BibTeX 0.99c-style `.bst` interpreter + `.bib` parser in Node.js (stdlib-only), with `.bbl` generation (79-col wrapping) and structured JSON logging/error output.

- Entry point: `output/main.js` (run as `node output/main.js ...`)
- Source files: `output/main.js`, `output/engine.js`, `output/bst_parser.js`, `output/bib_parser.js`, `output/builtins.js`, `output/output_buffer.js`, `output/util.js`
- Supports flags: `--bib`, `--style`, `--cites`, `--aux`, `--output`, `--log`
- Success: writes `.bbl` to `--output` (LF, UTF-8) and JSON log to `--log` (if provided)
- Failure (exit 1): writes error JSON to `--output` (and still writes JSON log if `--log` provided)

        """Two entries sharing the same first-author last name produce sort keys

        whose author starts with 'Smith'."""

            '@article{a, author = "John Smith", year = 2024}\n'

        { pop$ "Z" }
      if$
      cite$ swap$ * 'sort.key$ :=
    }
    FUNCTION {emit} { sort.key$ write$ newline$ }
    READ
    EXECUTE {init}
    ITERATE {assign.key}
    SORT
    ITERATE {emit}
    """
